about: What each Studio control does to the Studio fixture's preview of the live design (scripts/studio-control-audit.mjs). visible / css-only / dom-only = it changes the preview; CI fails if it stops. 'none: <reason>' = it can't show on the fixture page, with the reason. New controls must be added (AUDIT_UPDATE=1). See CLAUDE.md › Studio controls must reach the shop.
